name: AktivHotel Hochfilzer
beschreibung: The AktivHotel Hochfilzer in Ellmau is situated at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser mountain range. It offers rooms with balconies, a wellness area, and an outdoor pool. Half board includes regional specialties for breakfast and dinner. Hiking trails are directly accessible from the hotel, and in winter a complimentary ski bus connects the property with the SkiWelt area. The hotel is dedicated to sustainability, relying on solar power and regional suppliers. Guests can join guided tours, rent equipment, or use the indoor climbing hall. The furnishings are practical and the overall ambiance is warm and relaxed.
